verdict.rationale: Model failover is a fair question for a multi-provider chat platform like LibreChat, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic fallback to another provider or model on errors or rate limits. Custom endpoints and a LiteLLM proxy (an external tool) are adjacent features or user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
